title: Reference Angle for sin x = -1/2
text:
When $$\sin x = - rac{1}{2}$$:
- Reference angle: $$30°$$ (since $$\sin 30° =  rac{1}{2}$$)
- Sine is negative in Quadrants 3 and 4
- Q3: $$180° + 30° = 210°$$
- Q4: $$360° - 30° = 330°$$

title: Solution for sin x = 1
text: When $$\sin x = 1$$:\n- This only happens at $$x = 90°$$\n- General solution: $$x = 90° + 360°k$$, where $$k \in \mathbb{Z}$$

title: Complete General Solution
text:
**General Solution:**

$$x = 210° + 360°k$$ or $$x = 330° + 360°k$$ or $$x = 90° + 360°k$$

where $$k \in \mathbb{Z}$$ (k is any integer)
